clips.text: I know that the apprenticeship is very hard but worth it.
It is arduous, but one has to pay for everything, and in no other way can you get to the great treasure.
You have longed for it for lives and lives and now when the time is ripe and the key is being given to you do not lose courage.
Access to the treasure is difficult because it is hidden
in our own unconscious layers of the mind.
It will be easy if you approach that threshold when the diurnal tide is favorable, that is when you are passing from sleep to waking or from waking to sleep.
So evening and morning are probably the best times for meditation.
You might have noticed that when the mind is recovering from sleep it takes at least fifteen minutes to close one aperture and fully open the other.
